extension.summary: Browse and stream YouTube channels. No login, no API.
extension.description: A custom, unofficial YouTube browser for Kodi. Browse channels defined in channels.conf, search YouTube or within a channel, and stream or download videos in up to 720p using yt-dlp. Playlists are supported from your channels, from search results, and your own playlists created in the addon. Watch history tracks your progress and offers resume. Downloads are managed from the addon with a built-in list and delete option. No YouTube login or API key required. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google LLC or YouTube, LLC.
extension.news: 1.6.5 - Automatic cache cleanup (orphaned channel caches, age/count limits on search caches), configurable cache duration and retry cooldown, channel metadata expiry, atomic cache writes, cached popular and video info. 1.6.0 - Enhanced history: resume indicators in video lists, rich history with thumbnails and progress, delete individual history entries, better auto‑resume. 1.5.3 - Added manual refresh options: refresh all caches or refresh a single channel; automatic cache expiry after 24 hours. 1.4.0 - Playlists: browse your channels' playlists, playlist results in search, playlists you create in the addon (add or paste video links), and watch history with resume 1.3.0 - Added a Popular section (top videos from your channels by views) and Load more for YouTube search 1.2.1 - Load more now works without a JS runtime (yt-dlp binary must be provided) 1.2.0 - Added video download with progress and a Downloads manager (play/delete) 1.1.0 - Add and remove channels from the addon, per-channel search, error logging 1.0.0 - Initial release: channel browsing, YouTube search, streaming
